sentences.text: In short: TL FRISØR AS is an established company in "frisering og barbering" based in Lørenskog, profitable in 2025.
TL FRISØR AS is registered in the industry "Frisering og barbering"; its registered activity is "Frisør, frisering og annen skjønnhetspleie.".
TL FRISØR AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2014-01-02, registered in Lørenskog.
It reported revenue of NOK 1.06M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 95,031 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 8.9% and a strong equity ratio of 77% of total assets.
Revenue rose 4.7% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 1.02M to NOK 1.06M); it was NOK 991,778 in 2023. The annual result was a profit in 2025, as in 2024 (2023: -NOK 4,940, 2024: NOK 23,245, 2025: NOK 74,665).
TL FRISØR AS is led by Thuy Ngoc Thi Le, who is both CEO and board chair.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2020-11-07.
TL FRISØR AS has 1 registered workplace.
